svg.title: CYC complete method-selection map
svg.desc: The cyc orchestrator chooses methods by task need. All seventeen supporting methods have a selection condition and output. These are capabilities, not seventeen mandatory steps. Examples are available in each method's accessible description; links open its source instructions.
svg.text: 1 orchestrator selects from 17 methods and 15 playbooks. Four stages describe only the common implementation route.
Arrows show selection by need. Rows group responsibilities; they are not an execution sequence. Click a method to read its instructions.
Project setup, task entry, interruption or requested learning

a.aria-label: Setup: Project needs configuration. Example: discover CI commands, run them and disclose hook status.
a.title: Example: discover CI commands, run them and disclose hook status.

a.aria-label: Scout: Start a bounded engineering task. Example: locate the export path and the permission checks it must preserve.
a.title: Example: locate the export path and the permission checks it must preserve.

a.aria-label: Remember: Decision, checkpoint or resumption. Example: recover why a query was chosen; recheck files changed since the checkpoint.
a.title: Example: recover why a query was chosen; recheck files changed since the checkpoint.

a.aria-label: Teach: Engineer requests a lesson. Example: explain why visible page rows differ from all matching export records.
a.title: Example: explain why visible page rows differ from all matching export records.

svg.text: Unclear goal, behavior, alternatives, impact, design or claim

a.aria-label: Frame: What counts as success?. Example: all matching rows, not merely a downloaded CSV.
a.title: Example: all matching rows, not merely a downloaded CSV.

a.aria-label: Understand: Why does it behave this way?. Example: trace pagination from request to query.
a.title: Example: trace pagination from request to query.

a.aria-label: Explore: Which approach fits?. Example: compare paged fetch, streaming and queued export.
a.title: Example: compare paged fetch, streaming and queued export.

a.aria-label: Impact: What else could this affect?. Example: find permission and count consumers of the query.
a.title: Example: find permission and count consumers of the query.

a.aria-label: Design: How should the change work?. Example: define the export/query boundary and errors.
a.title: Example: define the export/query boundary and errors.

a.aria-label: Challenge: Does the plan or claim hold?. Example: question whether the export bypasses access filtering.
a.title: Example: question whether the export bypasses access filtering.

svg.text: Implement, verify or hand off the selected task

a.aria-label: Build: An agreed approach needs implementation. Example: repair retrieval in small slices; check duplicates before continuing.
a.title: Example: repair retrieval in small slices; check duplicates before continuing.

a.aria-label: Verify: A behavior claim needs current evidence. Example: inspect the full exported membership, permissions and CSV consumer.
a.title: Example: inspect the full exported membership, permissions and CSV consumer.
a.text: A behavior claim needs current evidence

a.aria-label: Deliver: The result needs a reviewable handoff. Example: explain the query change, show checks and identify unmeasured scale.
a.title: Example: explain the query change, show checks and identify unmeasured scale.
a.text: The result needs a reviewable handoff

svg.text: PRESERVE KNOWLEDGE AND RESPOND TO FINDINGS
Relevant history, failed attempts, user correction or reusable lessons

a.aria-label: Context: Before component work; useful findings. Example: retain observed query constraints with evidence; identify adopted decisions only with actual acceptance.
a.title: Example: retain observed query constraints with evidence; identify adopted decisions only with actual acceptance.

a.aria-label: Error Ledger: Before debugging; after failed attempts. Example: record that a paging fix duplicated rows and the check that exposed it.
a.title: Example: record that a paging fix duplicated rows and the check that exposed it.

a.aria-label: Correct: Feedback reveals a missing criterion. Example: “Not just the visible page” changes the target and its verification.
a.title: Example: “Not just the visible page” changes the target and its verification.

a.aria-label: Reflect: An outcome reveals a reusable improvement. Example: propose a multi-page check after a repeated omission; do not silently adopt rules.
a.title: Example: propose a multi-page check after a repeated omission; do not silently adopt rules.
a.text: An outcome reveals a reusable improvement

svg.text: The playbook sets the recorded sequence; the agent selects methods and interprets their findings. The controller does not invoke skills.
